description: neroAacEnc 1.5.4.0 and neroAacTag 1.5.4.0: neroAacEnc -lc -cbr 128000 -if music-44k-stereo.wav; neroAacTag -meta:title="Encspect cover test" -write-nd-covers -add-cover:front:cover.jpg, on the synthetic source music-44k-stereo.wav.

input.name: music-44k-stereo.wav
input.generator: sources/make_sources.py of the sample kit (written from nothing, reproducible byte for byte)

selected_for: a cover in neroAacTag's own box and in the iTunes metadata
note: The encoder stamps the time of the encode into the file; the file is committed as written, and checked by its content.
